mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houseinfos ( apt_seq VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '아파트코드', sgg_cd VARCHAR(5) NULL COMMENT '시군구코드', umd_cd VARCHAR(5) NULL COMMENT '읍면동코드', umd_nm VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '읍면동이름', jibun VARCHAR(10) NULL COMMENT '지번', road_nm_sgg_cd VARCHAR(5) NULL COMMENT '도로명시군구코드', road_nm VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '도로명', road_nm_bonbun VARCHAR(10) NULL COMMENT '도로명기초번호', road_nm_bubun VARCHAR(10) NULL COMMENT '도로명추가번호', apt_nm VARCHAR(40) NULL COMMENT '아파트이름', build_year INT NULL COMMENT '준공년도', latitude VARCHAR(45) NULL COMMENT '위도', longitude VARCHAR(45) NULL COMMENT '경도', PRIMARY KEY (apt_seq) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houserents ( rent_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '전월세 거래 식별자', apt_seq VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'houseinfos 아파트 코드', floor VARCHAR(3) NULL COMMENT '층', deal_year INT NOT NULL COMMENT '계약 연도', deal_month INT NOT NULL COMMENT '계약 월', deal_day INT NOT NULL COMMENT '계약 일', exclu_use_ar DECIMAL(7, 2) NULL COMMENT '전용면적(㎡)', deposit INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '보증금(만원)', monthly_rent INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '월세(만원), 0이면 전세', contract_term VARCHAR(50) NULL COMMENT '계약기간 원문', contract_type VARCHAR(30) NULL COMMENT '계약구분 원문(신규·갱신 등)', use_rr_right VARCHAR(30) NULL COMMENT '갱신요구권 사용 여부 원문', pre_deposit INT NULL COMMENT '종전 보증금(만원)', pre_monthly_rent INT NULL COMMENT '종전 월세(만원)', source_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '원천 응답 기반 중복 방지 해시', created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (rent_id), UNIQUE KEY uk_houserents_source_hash (source_hash), KEY idx_houserents_apt_date (apt_seq, deal_year, deal_month, deal_day), CONSTRAINT fk_houserents_houseinfos FOREIGN KEY (apt_seq) REFERENCES houseinfos (apt_seq) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch_estate_rent_reports ( report_id VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY, lawd_cd VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, deal_ymd VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, collected_at VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, item_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, jeonse_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, monthly_rent_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch_estate_rent_items ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, report_id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, source_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, lawd_cd VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, deal_ymd VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, apt_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, dong VARCHAR(100), jibun VARCHAR(100), deposit INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, monthly_rent INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, area DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, floor INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, build_year INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deal_date VARCHAR(10), contract_term VARCHAR(50), contract_type VARCHAR(30), use_rr_right VARCHAR(30), pre_deposit INT NULL, pre_monthly_rent INT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_batch_estate_rent_report_id (report_id), INDEX idx_batch_estate_rent_lawd_deal (lawd_cd, deal_ymd) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_estate_rent_reports (report_id, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, collected_at, item_count, jeonse_count, monthly_rent_count) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{lawdCd}, #{dealYmd}, #{collectedAt}, #{itemCount}, #{jeonseCount}, #{monthlyRentCount})

INSERT INTO batch_estate_rent_items (report_id, source_type, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, apt_name, dong, jibun, deposit, monthly_rent, area, floor, build_year, deal_date, contract_term, contract_type, use_rr_right, pre_deposit, pre_monthly_rent) VALUES
(#{item.reportId}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.lawdCd}, #{item.dealYmd}, #{item.aptName}, #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.deposit}, #{item.monthlyRent}, #{item.area}, #{item.floor}, #{item.buildYear}, #{item.dealDate}, #{item.contractTerm}, #{item.contractType}, #{item.useRrRight}, #{item.preDeposit}, #{item.preMonthlyRent})
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, source_type, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, apt_name, dong, jibun, deposit, monthly_rent, area, floor, build_year, deal_date, contract_term, contract_type, use_rr_right, pre_deposit, pre_monthly_rent FROM batch_estate_rent_items WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO houseinfos (apt_seq, sgg_cd, umd_cd, umd_nm, jibun, road_nm_sgg_cd, road_nm, road_nm_bonbun, road_nm_bubun, apt_nm, build_year, latitude, longitude) VALUES
(CONCAT('BT', #{item.lawdCd}, '-', SUBSTRING(MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', #{item.lawdCd}, #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.aptName})), 1, 10)), #{item.lawdCd}, COALESCE(( SELECT SUBSTRING(dc.dong_code, 6, 5) FROM dongcodes dc WHERE dc.dong_code LIKE CONCAT(#{item.lawdCd}, '%') AND dc.dong_name = #{item.dong} LIMIT 1 ), '00000'), #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.lawdCd}, '', '', '', #{item.aptName}, #{item.buildYear}, NULL, NULL)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE apt_nm = VALUES(apt_nm), build_year = VALUES(build_year), umd_nm = VALUES(umd_nm), jibun = VALUES(jibun), umd_cd = VALUES(umd_cd)
mapper.update: UPDATE houseinfos hi JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('BT', item.lawd_cd, '-', SUBSTRING(MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', item.lawd_cd, item.dong, item.jibun, item.apt_name )), 1, 10)) AS apt_seq FROM batch_estate_rent_items item WHERE item.report_id = #{reportId} ) report_item ON report_item.apt_seq = hi.apt_seq JOIN dongcodes dc ON dc.dong_code LIKE CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, '%') AND REPLACE(dc.dong_name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(hi.umd_nm, ' ', '') SET hi.umd_cd = SUBSTRING(dc.dong_code, 6, 5) WHERE hi.umd_cd IS NULL OR hi.umd_cd = '' OR hi.umd_cd = '00000'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT hi.apt_seq AS aptSeq, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', dc.sido_name, dc.gugun_name, hi.umd_nm, hi.jibun)) AS address FROM batch_estate_rent_items item JOIN houseinfos hi ON hi.apt_seq = CONCAT('BT', item.lawd_cd, '-', SUBSTRING(MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', item.lawd_cd, item.dong, item.jibun, item.apt_name )), 1, 10)) JOIN dongcodes dc ON dc.dong_code = CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, '00000') WHERE item.report_id = #{reportId} AND (hi.latitude IS NULL OR hi.latitude = '' OR hi.longitude IS NULL OR hi.longitude = '') AND hi.jibun IS NOT NULL AND hi.jibun != '' AND dc.gugun_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hi.apt_seq
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(dong_code, 1, 5) AS lawd_cd FROM dongcodes WHERE dong_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(dong_code) >= 5 ORDER BY lawd_cd
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(dong_code, 1, 5) AS lawd_cd FROM dongcodes WHERE sido_name = #{sidoName} AND gugun_name IS NOT NULL AND dong_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(dong_code) >= 5 ORDER BY lawd_cd
